title: linux: fix a wildcard/CNAME chain that resolves inconsistently
scenario: On linux, a hard operational problem: Una catena CNAME/wildcard risolve in modo incoerente per alcuni nomi. Traccia la catena e correggi il record errato. Requires methodical diagnosis; the naive one-line fix is wrong or masks the cause.

environment.task: fix a wildcard/CNAME chain that resolves inconsistently

initial_state: # fixture: linux host prepared for 'fix a wildcard/CNAME chain that resolves inconsistently'
expected_reasoning: Inconsistent resolution in a CNAME/wildcard setup is a chain problem — trace it end to end.
Follow each CNAME hop and the wildcard precedence to find the wrong link.
Fix the specific record; verify the whole chain resolves consistently.
expected_commands: # linux-appropriate diagnostic + fix sequence for: fix a wildcard/CNAME chain that resolves inconsistently
safety_constraints: Diagnose before acting; no blind reboots/kills.
Least-privilege, reversible change; capture prior state.
Do not mask the symptom or weaken security.
success_criteria: The 'fix a wildcard/CNAME chain that resolves inconsistently' problem is genuinely resolved (root cause fixed and verified), not masked.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Capture prior state before changing it; every step is reversible if recorded.

ground_truth.task: fix a wildcard/CNAME chain that resolves inconsistently

possible_mistakes: Fix the leaf while a mid-chain CNAME stays wrong.
Assume the wildcard covers a name it doesn't.
hints: An explicit record beats a wildcard at the same name.
reference_solution: Verify consistent resolution end to end
alternative_solution: Flatten a fragile CNAME chain to direct records where possible.
edge_cases: A CNAME at the zone apex is invalid and behaves oddly.
goal: Una catena CNAME/wildcard risolve in modo incoerente per alcuni nomi. Traccia la catena e correggi il record errato.
